item.title: Simple Bundt Caramel Rolls
item.description: Creamy caramel rolls are quick and easy to prepare thanks to refrigerated biscuit dough, cream, and brown sugar.

item.title: Easy Pancake Mix Muffins with Pumpkin and Ginger
item.description: This recipe makes use of pancake mix, pumpkin puree, and ground ginger to create easy muffins finished with a sweet glaze.

item.title: Coconut Coffee Muffins
item.description: These coconut coffee muffins, made with coconut flour and shredded coconut, are a gluten-free treat that are quick and easy to prepare.

item.title: Chocolate-Ricotta Muffins
item.description: These chocolate-ricotta cheese muffins are fantastic. Great for breakfast, a snack, and also great in lunch boxes.

item.title: Cheese Bread Braid
item.description: This bread braid filled with mozzarella cheese and herbs comes together quickly due to the use of frozen bread dough.

item.title: Nadia's Easy Pumpkin Cornbread Muffins
item.description: Quick and easy pumpkin cornbread muffins made are the perfect breakfast treat on a fall or winter morning.

item.title: Za'atar Pull-Apart Rolls
item.description: An easy homemade dough is dipped in za'atar and olive oil to make these savory Middle Eastern-inspired pull-apart rolls that smell so good!

item.title: Irish Brown Bread
item.description: This Irish brown bread recipe comes together in no time with flour, oats, and baking soda for a hearty quick bread that's rich, tender, and full of flavor.

item.title: Amish Friendship Bread
item.description: This delicious Amish friendship bread is sweet and moist with a hint of cinnamon. This recipe makes 2 loaves - one for you and one for gifting!

item.title: Amish Friendship Bread Starter
item.description: This Amish friendship bread starter recipe combines yeast, sugar, milk, and flour to create a sweet fermented sourdough starter to share with friends.

item.title: Carrot Bread
item.description: This cakey carrot bread is moist and delicious, bursting with shredded carrots, raisins, flaked coconut, maraschino cherries, and nuts.

item.title: Cinnamon-Chocolate Chip Bread
item.description: Each slice of this homemade yeast bread, full of semisweet chocolate chips and a cinnamon-sugar swirl, is beautiful to look at and so delicious, it'll be gone before you know it!

item.title: Cheeseburger Muffins
item.description: Baking cheeseburger ingredients and condiments into a quick bread delivers an item that works equally well for a brunch item or for football snacks.
